chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Zurārah, who said:
I said to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام: The two rakʿahs that are before al-ghadāh, where is their place? He said: Before the rising of al-fajr; for when al-fajr rises, the time of al-ghadāh has entered.

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَانِ: the two units of prayer intended here as the two rakʿahs before fajr
key_terms.الْغَدَاةِ: the morning salat, referring here to salat al-fajr
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ: the rising or appearance of fajr
key_terms.مَوْضِعُهُمَا: their proper place or appointed time
key_terms.وَقْتُ الْغَدَاةِ: the beginning time of the morning salat

ai.seo_question: When is the time for the two rakʿahs before the morning salat according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the time of the two rakʿahs of fajr before the obligatory morning salat. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that they are to be performed before the appearance of fajr, and once fajr rises, the time of the morning salat begins.
